name: Avirup Basu
title: CTO & Co-founder, Kernopy
tagline: I and my team build Kernopy, an industrial AI native operations platform for every assets and every plant.
description: Avirup Basu is CTO & co-founder of Kernopy, an edge-to-cloud Industrial IoT platform built in Rust. Author of two books on IoT.
bio: I'm the CTO and co-founder of Kernopy,and I'm based in Siliguri, West Bengal, India.
Before Kernopy, I was at P360, where I built IoT solutions and enterprise messaging systems for the pharmaceutical industry, designed systems that had to scale, and was granted a patent.
I've written two books on IoT and published research papers. I'm also part of the developer community in Siliguri through GDG Siliguri.
